components.css: .ds-board { padding: 6px; background: var(--board, #0e0e0d); border-radius: 5px; width: 260px; } .ds-flap { --gap: max(2px, calc(7% / var(--n))); container-type: inline-size; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--n), minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap); color: var(--tile-yellow, #ffc917); font-family: "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tile { position: relative; aspect-ratio: .7; border-radius: max(2px, 5cqi / var(--n)); font-size: calc(100cqi / var(--n) * 1.12); line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05), 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5); } .ds-half { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 50%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tile-top, #252523); } .ds-top { top: 0; border-radius: inherit; border-bottom-left-radius: 0; border-bottom-right-radius: 0; } .ds-bottom { bottom: 0; background: var(--tile-bottom, #1b1b19); border-radius: inherit; border-top-left-radius: 0; border-top-right-radius: 0; } .ds-half > span { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 200%; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-top > span { top: 0; } .ds-bottom > span { bottom: 0; } .ds-tile::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(50% - .5px); height: 1px; background: #000; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06); }

components.css: .ds-net { display: grid; gap: 20px; padding: 28px; background: var(--blue, #0b3d91); color: var(--blue-ink, #f3f4f1); } .ds-net-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin: 0; font: 800 2rem/1 "Big Shoulders Display", "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-bullet { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); color: var(--blue-deep, #082d6b); font: 800 1.5rem/1 "Big Shoulders Display", "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; } .ds-stops { position: relative; display: flex; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; height: 64px; align-items: flex-end; font: 600 .95rem/1.15 "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-stops::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 14px; height: 8px; background: var(--c); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-stops li { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; padding-right: 6px; } .ds-stops li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: -41px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue-ink, #f3f4f1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--blue-deep, #082d6b); } .ds-stops li.is-now::before { background: var(--yellow, #ffc917); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--blue-deep, #082d6b), 0 0 0 7px var(--yellow, #ffc917); } .ds-now { margin-left: 4px; color: var(--yellow, #ffc917); font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .14em; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a bright station concourse: cool platform-white floor, ink type, full-width rules, and one mounted split-flap board hanging from the ceiling at the top. Everything that carries information speaks in the vocabulary of transit signage: departures with codes and sectors, routes drawn as lines with stops, a timetable, a network map of coloured lines, a boarding call. The board's dark tile material is the only dark object on the concourse; its family (the mini board in the sign bar, the code, sector and year boards, the portrait frame, the footer) all share it.

Colour is committed, not sprinkled. Signal yellow and platform blue arrive as whole flooded sections that cut hard against the concourse, the way a station paints whole walls in line colour. Type runs in two voices plus a signage label: a condensed display face for names and headings, a highway-sign grotesk for reading, and a condensed uppercase label for every piece of wayfinding. Hierarchy comes from case, size and rule weight, not from boxes.

Motion is mechanical. Tiles flip leaf by leaf through the drum in order; routes and lines draw themselves in left to right with stops popping on in sequence. Nothing floats, glows or fades in for decoration. With reduced motion, everything renders settled.
keyCharacteristics: One dark object family (the board material) on a light concourse.
Whole-section colour floods in yellow and blue with hard edges.
Condensed display face + grotesk body + condensed uppercase labels.
Transit-native structures: split-flap rows, route lines with stops, timetable rows, network lines, ticket rows.
Full-width 2px ink rules and 1px hairlines instead of cards.
Mechanical, ordered motion that is fully removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Flood Rule
rules.body: Yellow and blue are applied as whole-section floods or whole-row fills with hard edges, never as tints, gradients or soft washes. A section is either concourse, blue or yellow.

rules.name: The One Dark Object Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces are reserved for the board material and its family (mini board, code/sector/year boards, portrait frame) plus the ink controls and footer. No dark cards or dark sections elsewhere.

rules.name: The Yellow Is A Field Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow never sets type directly on the concourse (1.4:1). It appears as a field under ink type, or as type on ink, board or blue.

rules.name: The Line Colour Rule
rules.body: Route and network colours mark tracks, terminus rings and bullets only; text stays ink, concourse or tile ink.

rules.name: The Case Carries Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Display and label voices are always uppercase; body copy is always sentence case. Weight 800 belongs to the display face only.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Every text element uses exactly one of display, body or condensed label. No fourth face, no monospace, no italics.

rules.name: The Mounted Object Rule
rules.body: Only things that would physically hang or sit in a station (the board, the framed portrait, the boarding strip) cast shadows. Rows, sections and text never do.

dos: **Do** flood whole sections in yellow or blue with hard edges, and keep every other section on the concourse.
**Do** present any short code, year, sector or status as a split-flap row, with `--n` equal to its `data-length` and glyphs sized in `cqi`.
**Do** draw sequences and systems as lines with stops: 8px track, round stops, coloured termini.
**Do** set structured data as ruled rows (2px ink between groups, 1px hairline within), not cards.
**Do** keep wayfinding text in the condensed uppercase label voice with .06em to .18em tracking.
**Do** keep motion mechanical and ordered, and render everything settled when reduced motion is requested.
donts: **Don't** add dark sections, dark cards or a dark mode; the board family is the only dark material.
**Don't** use pill chips, badges or tag clouds for skills or tech; stacks are stops on a line.
**Don't** use glass, backdrop blur, glows or gradient hero fields.
**Don't** set signal yellow type on the concourse.
**Don't** cast shadows from rows, sections or text; only mounted objects carry depth.
**Don't** add a fourth typeface, monospace or italic.
**Don't** fade or float elements in for decoration; motion is flips and draw-ins only.
